title: EV Battery Production Analytics
thesis: Snowflake detects battery cell anomalies across 6 gigafactories, classifies defect patterns with AI, forecasts production yield, and alerts engineers — all native SQL, replacing SageMaker and custom ML pipelines

talking_points: Eight hundred fifty million baht in annual scrap cost across 6 gigafactories in the EEC.
Three production lines below 90% yield target — Line-03, Line-14, Line-27.
Twelve thermal events flagged in the last 72 hours.
show: Point at the ฿850M scrap cost KPI card

transition.line: Let's drill into which lines are degrading and why.

talking_points: Line-03 in Rayong producing NCM811 cells — yield at 87.2%, below 90% target.
Formation cycling data shows capacity spread widening — electrolyte fill variance suspected.
ML.ANOMALY_DETECTION confirms: 9 of the last 14 days anomalous for Line-03.
show: Click Line-03 in the line list
Show yield trend with anomaly markers

transition.line: The yield is broken. Let's trace it to material quality.

talking_points: Supplier material quality correlates with yield drops — cathode Batch-CH2847 showing purity variance.
Dynamic Table joins supplier CoA data with cell test results in real time.
ML.FORECAST predicts Line-03 yield will drop below 85% within 5 days without intervention.
show: Show forecast trend with confidence band
tabs.call_out: Cathode batch purity variance → 5-day yield collapse predicted

transition.line: Now let the VP ask the system directly.

talking_points: Somchai asks: 'What is our total scrap cost this quarter by plant?'
Cortex Analyst generates SQL, returns answer: Rayong ฿340M, Chonburi ฿290M, Chachoengsao ฿220M.
Switch to advisor: 'What should we do about Line-03?' — searches quality docs and recommends corrective actions.
show: Type: 'Total scrap cost by plant this quarter'
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: SQL analytics + root-cause advisory

talking_points: Eight Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services.
IoT Core ingests 600K sensor readings → Snowpipe Streaming → Dynamic Tables → ML.ANOMALY_DETECTION.
Thailand's EV production target: 725,000 units by 2030. This monitors 6 plants, 36 lines, 8,000 batches.
show: Point at Thailand EV policy context
tabs.call_out: One platform, native SQL, open Iceberg

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for EV battery manufacturing in Thailand.
